verdict.rationale: SigNoz documents an official MCP server that gives Claude, Cursor, Copilot and other agents natural-language access to metrics, logs, traces, alerts and dashboards. It also publishes Agent Skills that let assistants generate queries, create and modify dashboards, and manage alerts, plus documented use cases such as dashboard creation from natural language. This NL operation runs through external AI clients rather than a native in-app assistant, and every source is vendor documentation. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, independent or hands-on corroboration that the NL workflows work as described.
